reason: This is the only available combination and advances the remaining goal.
expectation: The exposed gas and dust will escape the inner disk, possibly returning to the surrounding galaxy.

effect: The exposed gas and dust escape into the nursery early, completing the remaining goal and clarifying that this occurs before the rocky world's later impacts.
reaction: The contrast between the two timescales was more interesting than the escape itself.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the moon-bearing world through impacts was most worthwhile: the craters show a lasting effect while the moon survives.

leastWorthwhile.text: The disk-material action felt least engaging as a decision because it was the only remaining combination, even though its result clarified the timeline.

surprise.text: The gas and dust escaped early, while the rocky world's collisions continued much later; the chapter presents those histories alongside each other rather than in sequence.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: both matched an explicit goal, though the second offered no meaningful choice at that point.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the linked histories develop, though this short chapter's limited choices were not a strong hook on their own.
